verdict.rationale: Brevo documents a sandbox mode that lets users test transactional emails without actually sending them. That is a product-native capability, but it works as a send-suppression (dry-run-style) flag on the email API, not an isolated sandbox environment with separate data, and no other API surface is shown to run against non-production data. missing for 10: an isolated sandbox or test environment separate from production account data, sandbox coverage beyond transactional email (contacts, campaigns, SMS), detailed docs on sandbox behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Test transactional emails without sending them using sandbox mode
